digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation scoping and code freshness
propositions: A declared none file-impact scope should skip whole-HEAD drift checks and remain valid after unrelated commits, while undeclared empty-impact attestations must still return stale-head
The manifest signing flow must classify dependency scopes into three states (paths, none, unscoped) and emit file-scope: none only for truthfully declared none impact
A none-scope declaration present only in unauthenticated plaintext cannot suppress stale-head validity; it must be authenticated in the signed manifest
Scope changes between none and paths, or reason-only edits to no_file_impact_reason, must invalidate the material fingerprint and produce stale-material verdicts
The resign_plan_review recovery path must preserve none scope through the same signing boundary without new branches
Legacy pre-feature manifests without file-scope declarations must retain unscoped validity semantics for backward compatibility
